title: Fire Doors
activity: Fire door leaf, frame, seals and ironmongery
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Is the certification label on top of the leaf present and undamaged?
Is the leaf plumb, level and square with a consistent gap to the frame?
Are frame-to-wall fixings the right number, type and position?
Are intumescent seals full length on all sides, flush in their grooves and undamaged?
Does the smoke seal fill the gap between door and frame on all sides?
Does the latch engage securely, and is ironmongery suitable for the fire rating?
Is the third-party certificate available for this door?
